collection.title: VW Passat Saloon 2005 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a VW Passat Saloon 2005 to 2012 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
